title: 对数的核与像
Kernels and images of the logarithm
setup: 域 K 上的向量空间；幂零算子 D；任意截断参数 m。
A vector space over a field K; a nilpotent operator D; any truncation parameter m.
result: D 乘一个交换的可逆因子，保持所有幂的核、像与幂零指数。
Multiplying D by a commuting unit preserves every power kernel, image and the nilpotency class.
scope: 已验证的是所定义多项式的过滤等式。解释为真正的对数还要求特征零及 D^(m+2)=0。
The checked claim concerns the defined polynomial. Its identification with the actual logarithm additionally requires characteristic zero and D^(m+2)=0.
nodes.formalType:
variable {K V : Type*} [Field K]
  [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]

theorem logarithmicChains (D : Module.End K V) (hD : IsNilpotent D) (m : ℕ) :
    IsNilpotent (logFinite D m) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ,
      LinearMap.ker ((logFinite D m) ^ j) = LinearMap.ker (D ^ j) ∧
      LinearMap.range ((logFinite D m) ^ j) = LinearMap.range (D ^ j) ∧
      ((logFinite D m) ^ j = 0 ↔ D ^ j = 0)) ∧
    nilpotencyClass (logFinite D m) = nilpotencyClass D

title: 广义特征分量的乘积
Products of generalized eigenvectors
setup: 域 K 上的三个向量空间、等变双线性映射 B；两个分量分别被移位算子的 p、q 次幂消去。
Three vector spaces over a field K, an equivariant bilinear map B, and factors killed by shifted powers p and q.
result: 乘积被对应移位算子的 p+q−1 次幂消去。
The product is killed by the corresponding shifted power p+q−1.
scope: 这是对分量的结论；任意向量的谱分解与幺幂部分的乘法相容性仍待连接。
This is the componentwise result. The spectral decomposition and multiplicativity of the unipotent part still need to be connected.
nodes.formalType:
variable {K V W Z : Type*} [Field K]
  [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
  [AddCommGroup Z] [Module K Z]

theorem generalizedProduct (B : V →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] Z)
    (T : Module.End K V) (S : Module.End K W) (R : Module.End K Z)
    (h : ∀ x y, R (B x y) = B (T x) (S y)) (a b : K)
    (p q : ℕ) (x : V) (y : W)
    (hx : ((T-a • 1)^p) x = 0) (hy : ((S-b • 1)^q) y = 0) :
    ((R-(a*b) • 1)^(p+q-1)) (B x y) = 0

title: 有限指数流
Finite exponential flow
setup: 有理向量空间；幂零算子 D；有理参数 s,t。
A rational vector space, a nilpotent operator D, and rational parameters s,t.
result: 指数流满足加法、逆元与非负整数次幂公式。
The finite exponential satisfies addition, inverse and nonnegative integer-power identities.
scope: 直接复用 mathlib 的有限指数。尚未证明这里的 D 等于 log(Tᵤ)。
Reuses mathlib’s finite exponential. This does not yet identify D with log(Tᵤ).
nodes.formalType:
variable {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℚ V]

theorem nilpotentFlow (D : Module.End ℚ V) (hD : IsNilpotent D) :
    flow D 0 = 1 ∧
    (∀ s t : ℚ, flow D (s+t) = flow D s * flow D t) ∧
    (∀ t : ℚ, IsUnit (flow D t)) ∧
    (∀ t : ℚ, flow D t * flow D (-t) = 1 ∧ flow D (-t) * flow D t = 1) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ, flow D (m : ℚ) = (flow D 1)^m)

title: 乘法 Jordan 分解
Multiplicative Jordan decomposition
setup: 完美域 K 上的有限维向量空间；可逆算子 T。
A finite-dimensional vector space over a perfect field K and an invertible operator T.
result: T=SU，S 半单且可逆，U 幺幂且可逆，SU=US；S 是 T 的多项式。
T=SU with commuting units S,U, S semisimple and U unipotent; S is a polynomial in T.
scope: 由 mathlib 的加法 Jordan–Chevalley 分解推出。标量扩张与多重线性映射相容性尚待接入。
Derived from mathlib’s additive Jordan–Chevalley decomposition. Scalar extensions and multilinear compatibility remain to be integrated.
nodes.formalType:
variable {K V : Type*} [Field K] [PerfectField K]
  [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]

theorem multiplicativeDecomposition (T : Module.End K V) (hT : IsUnit T) :
    ∃ S U : Module.End K V,
      S ∈ Algebra.adjoin K {T} ∧ S.IsSemisimple ∧ IsUnit S ∧
      IsNilpotent (U-1) ∧ IsUnit U ∧ Commute S U ∧ T = S*U

title: 形式对数与指数互逆
Formal logarithm and exponential
setup: 有理系数的一元形式幂级数。
Univariate formal power series with rational coefficients.
result: exp(log(1+X))=1+X and log(exp(X))=X, interpreted by formal substitution.
scope: 复用 mathlib 已证明的互逆定理。求值到幂零算子、识别有限和的桥梁尚未完成。
Reuses mathlib’s inverse identities. Evaluation at a nilpotent operator and identification with the finite sums remain open.
nodes.formalType:
theorem seriesLogExp :
    (PowerSeries.exp ℚ).subst (PowerSeries.log ℚ) =
        1 + (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries ℚ) ∧
    (PowerSeries.log ℚ).subst (PowerSeries.exp ℚ - 1) =
        (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries ℚ)
